name: DVC Summer Career Academies
city: Pleasant Hill, CA (some at the San Ramon campus)
what_you_do: Try a career field in a short college class made for high school students. You learn by doing and go on field trips. You earn college credit.
who_can_apply: The classes are made for high school students. In summer they are open to all students. You must come every day. Fields include animation, business, computer programming, health, robotics and trades.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the academies page.
duration: Short courses of about 1 to 2 weeks. 2027 dates posted so far: Public Safety July 6 to 16, Robotics July 6 to 17, Business July 12 to 23, Health and Animation July 26 to 30.
deadline_text: Some 2027 academy dates are posted. Others are not. The page lists these steps: apply to DVC for summer now, send the Special Admissions form starting in March, and sign up in the student portal starting in May.
how_to_apply: Apply to DVC for summer. Then send the Special Admissions Recommendation Form, signed by you, a parent and your counselor. Then sign up for your academy in the student portal. Use the interest form on the page for updates.
notes: The Special Admissions form is for students who are not graduating this spring or earlier.
